# Cue 0.9.0 — GPT and app search / GPT 與 App 搜尋
## English
Cue 0.9.0 adds quick GPT answers and translation, broader app-name matching, personal search aliases, and a fix for missing Finder results.
- **Choose what to do with your text:** unmatched queries now offer **Search Google**, **Ask GPT**, and **Translate with GPT**, in that order. Press **Command+K** to see these actions even when an app matches, then use the displayed **Command+number** or Return. Your selected Google browsers remain available; more than six additional browsers fit under **Other Browsers…**. - **Short answers and translation:** replies stream into a selectable text view with Copy, Stop and explicit Retry. **Command+Return** copies the reply, and **Esc** returns to your original text. Translation defaults to **Chinese → English; other languages → Traditional Chinese with Taiwan terminology**. GPT Settings also offers fixed Traditional Chinese or English targets. - **Your API key and model:** search `gpt settings`, or press **Command+,** on a GPT action or reply. Save your own OpenAI API key in macOS Keychain and enable Cue's network access. API usage is billed separately from ChatGPT subscriptions. The default model is **GPT-6 Luna**, with extra reasoning disabled for quick tasks; you can enter another Responses-compatible model ID in these settings. - **Explicit network use:** typing and opening the action list never send a GPT request. Only executing an action sends the entered text and task instructions to OpenAI. Turning Cue networking off cancels pending work and prevents new requests; enabling it again does not retry automatically. Cue saves no GPT conversation history and excludes questions and replies from search learning. Copied replies follow normal Clipboard History settings. OpenAI's own data retention policies still apply; sent text and possible charges cannot be recalled. - **Find apps by more names:** Cue searches display names, bundle names and app filenames without duplicate results. **Code** can match `visual`, `vs` or `vsc`. Select an app and press **Command+E**, click **…**, or use its context menu to set a personal alias. Exact aliases take priority over ordinary matches and survive reindexing. Duplicate app or conversion aliases are rejected. - **Finder is searchable:** the index now includes Finder's system bundle directly, without exposing unrelated CoreServices background helpers.
GPT is a single-turn utility with no live web search; choose Google for current information and source discovery. Input is limited to 32 KiB; output is capped at 2,048 tokens for answers and 4,096 for translation. Interrupted or capped replies are marked incomplete. See the [GPT guide](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.9.0/docs/gpt.md) and [app search guide](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.9.0/README.md#app-names-and-search-aliases--app-名稱與搜尋別名).
### Install or upgrade
[Download Cue 0.9.0](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.9.0/Cue-0.9.0-universal.dmg) · [Checksums](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.9.0/SHA256SUMS.txt)
With Cue network access enabled, choose **Check for Updates…**, then **Install and Relaunch**. Or quit Cue, open the DMG, and drag **Cue.app** into **Applications**, replacing the old copy. Open the installed app and press **Option+Space**. Existing settings, clipboard history and search learning are preserved. Updating requires a writable installed location, not the read-only DMG. Cue does not download or install updates unattended.
To build your own copy, install full **Xcode with Swift 6 or later**, open it once to finish setup and licensing, quit Cue, then run:
```sh git clone https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue.git cd cue ./scripts/install-app.sh open "$HOME/Applications/Cue.app" ```
The optimized app stays installed at `~/Applications/Cue.app`; the first build downloads the pinned Sparkle dependency. To update, quit Cue, run `git pull --ff-only` and `./scripts/install-app.sh` in the same repository, then reopen it. Source builds default to Cue-owned networking and automatic update checks **off**; official DMGs default to **on**. Explicit saved choices are preserved. GPT and currency conversion follow that network choice; browser search retains its separate, enabled-by-default switch. Installing an in-app update replaces a source build with the published app. See the [source guide](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.9.0/docs/building.md).
### Installation and testing limits
The app is ad hoc-signed, **without Developer ID signing or Apple notarization**. If macOS blocks first launch, follow the app-specific [installation instructions](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.9.0/docs/installation.md). Chinese text replacement still requires Accessibility permission for the installed copy; rebuilding or updating can invalidate an older grant.
Optimized automated checks cover GPT streaming, cancellation, network gating, settings and keyboard interactions using injected API responses and isolated credentials. Local interface checks covered action selection, returning to the original query, settings focus and the missing-key state. **Live OpenAI replies, API latency and real Keychain authorization remain unverified.** The default model is selected from OpenAI's documentation, not a Cue model-quality benchmark.
The universal app targets **macOS 14+**, with Apple silicon and Intel binaries. Runtime verification is on **Apple silicon / macOS 27.0 / Xcode 27**. Intel, other macOS versions, first installation on another Mac, and a complete public update installation remain unverified. Actual sleep, lock, display-off and logout/reboot login-item cycles were not exercised for this release.
## 正體中文
Cue 0.9.0 加入快速 GPT 問答與翻譯、更多 App 名稱搜尋、個人搜尋別名，並修正 找不到 Finder 的問題。
- **選擇如何處理輸入文字：**沒有符合結果時，依序提供 **Google 搜尋**、 **問 GPT**、**GPT 翻譯**。即使有 App 符合，也可按 **Command+K** 叫出這些 動作，再按顯示的 **Command+數字**或 Return。自行選擇的 Google 瀏覽器仍 可使用；超過六個額外瀏覽器時，收進**其他瀏覽器⋯**。 - **簡短回答與翻譯：**回答逐步顯示且可選取文字，提供拷貝、停止與手動重試。 **Command+Return** 拷貝回答，**Esc** 返回原本輸入的文字。翻譯預設為 **中文→英文，其他語言→正體中文（台灣用詞）**；也可在 GPT 設定固定翻成 正體中文或英文。 - **自己的 API 金鑰與模型：**輸入 `gpt settings`，或在 GPT 動作／回答頁按 **Command+,**，將自己的 OpenAI API 金鑰存進 macOS 鑰匙圈，並允許 Cue 自行連網。API 與 ChatGPT 訂閱分開計費。預設採用 **GPT-6 Luna**、關閉 額外推理以適合短任務；可在此設定其他支援 Responses 的模型 ID。 - **明確操作才使用網路：**打字與開啟動作清單都不會發出 GPT 請求，只有 執行動作才將輸入文字與任務指示傳到 OpenAI。關閉 Cue 網路會取消等待中的 工作並阻止新請求，重新允許也不會自動重試。Cue 不保存 GPT 對話歷史，提問 與回答不加入搜尋學習；拷貝的回答依一般剪貼簿記錄設定處理。OpenAI 端仍 適用自己的資料保留政策，已送出的文字及可能產生的費用無法收回。 - **更多 App 名稱可搜尋：**同時搜尋顯示名稱、Bundle 名稱與 App 檔名，不 重複顯示結果。**Code** 可用 `visual`、`vs` 或 `vsc` 找到。選取 App 後按 **Command+E**、點 **…** 或使用右鍵選單，即可設定個人別名；完整別名 優先於一般符合結果，更新索引後仍保留。不能與其他 App 或簡繁轉換別名重複。 - **可以搜尋 Finder：**直接將 Finder 的系統 App 加入索引，不將其他 CoreServices 背景輔助程式列為結果。
GPT 是單次問答工具，沒有即時網頁搜尋；近期資訊與來源查找請用 Google。 輸入上限為 32 KiB，問答最多輸出 2,048 tokens，翻譯最多 4,096 tokens；中斷 或達到上限會標示未完成。詳見 [GPT 說明](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.9.0/docs/gpt.md)及 [App 搜尋說明](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.9.0/README.md#app-names-and-search-aliases--app-名稱與搜尋別名)。
### 安裝或升級
[下載 Cue 0.9.0](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.9.0/Cue-0.9.0-universal.dmg) · [檢查碼](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.9.0/SHA256SUMS.txt)
允許 Cue 使用網路後，選擇**檢查更新⋯**，再依提示安裝並重新啟動（**Install and Relaunch**）；或先結束 Cue，開啟 DMG，將 **Cue.app** 拖進**應用程式** 取代舊版，再開啟安裝好的 App，按 **Option+Space**。原有設定、剪貼簿記錄與 搜尋學習資料都會保留。更新需要可寫入的安裝位置，不能直接在唯讀 DMG 中 執行；Cue 不會在無人操作時自行下載或安裝更新。
自行編譯需要內含 **Swift 6 以上的完整 Xcode**，先開啟完成設定與授權、 結束 Cue，再執行：
```sh git clone https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue.git cd cue ./scripts/install-app.sh open "$HOME/Applications/Cue.app" ```
最佳化 App 會固定安裝至 `~/Applications/Cue.app`，首次建置下載固定版本的 Sparkle。更新時先結束 Cue，在同一份儲存庫執行 `git pull --ff-only` 與 `./scripts/install-app.sh`，再重新開啟。自行建置版預設**關閉** Cue 自行連網 與自動檢查更新，正式 DMG 預設**開啟**；明確儲存的選擇會保留。GPT 與幣值 換算遵守該網路選擇，瀏覽器搜尋則有獨立、預設開啟的開關。若從 Cue 安裝 更新，會將自行建置版換成發布版。詳見 [原始碼指引](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.9.0/docs/building.md)。
### 安裝與驗證限制
App 使用 ad hoc 簽章，**沒有 Developer ID 簽署，也未經 Apple 公證**。若 macOS 阻擋首次開啟，請依針對 Cue 的 [安裝說明](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.9.0/docs/installation.md)操作。 簡繁文字取代仍需要為目前安裝的 Cue 開啟輔助使用權限；重新建置或更新可能 使舊授權失效。
最佳化自動檢查使用注入的 API 回應及隔離的金鑰資料，涵蓋 GPT 串流、取消、 網路許可、設定與鍵盤操作。本機介面確認了動作選擇、返回保留查詢、設定焦點 與未設定金鑰時的提示。**真實 OpenAI 回答、API 延遲與實際鑰匙圈授權尚未 驗證。**預設模型依 OpenAI 官方文件選擇，並非 Cue 的模型品質評測結果。
通用版目標為 **macOS 14+**，包含 Apple silicon 與 Intel 執行檔。實際執行 驗證環境為 **Apple silicon／macOS 27.0／Xcode 27**；Intel、其他 macOS 版本、 另一台 Mac 的首次安裝及完整公開更新安裝流程仍未驗證。本次發布未實際測試 睡眠、鎖定、關閉顯示器及登出／重開機後登入啟動的完整循環。
